title: QMMH/Tšepong nurses’ salary-grievance strike (possible January onset; physical public assembly unresolved)
scope: Hospital workforce action; whether and when workers assembled publicly in January is unresolved.
organizer: Lesotho Nursing Association is described by DDPR as allegedly leading the continuing strike; source dates conflict.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown for January. The DDPR report does not report a January public crowd. SABC reports more than 300 health workers had been picketing during the later February action, but that count is not transferred to January.

start_date.summary: Conflicting dates: the DDPR says “sometime in January”; contemporary SABC, Sunday Express and Netcare say Feb 1; Africa-Press says Feb 2; the U.S. State Department report also dates the strike Feb 1–Mar 11. Exact physical onset and whether these refer to one action are unresolved.

location.summary: Sources locate the nursing action at QMMH/Tšepong in Maseru.

organizer.summary: DDPR report says the continuing strike was allegedly led by the Lesotho Nursing Association and involved nursing staff.

demands.summary: Later reports describe salary review/increases; DDPR discusses salary disputes but says the continuing strike was different from the formally referred LEWA dispute. The government salary-review undertaking under the PPP is reported by Netcare and Sunday Express.

participants.summary: No January count is available. SABC’s “more than 300” picketing figure is for the February action only and is not applied to January.

threshold_50.summary: No evidence yet identifies a January public assembly or a concurrent crowd of at least 50; February picketing evidence cannot satisfy the January threshold.

state_response.summary: All seven response fields remain unknown; no event-specific January response is established.

notes: Retain as an unresolved source-only lead because the official DDPR report states a January strike onset, while multiple contemporary/later reports give Feb 1 or Feb 2. No physical January date is assigned. A strike alone does not prove a public assembly; neither the Jan 27 deadline nor Jan 18 hospital management notice is treated as an executed protest. The 300+ February picket figure is not a January headcount. SABC’s report of an interim interdict/return-to-work does not independently establish the last physical gathering; end_date remains null. Do not merge, split, approve, or transfer the candidate without coordinator review.
open_questions: Does the DDPR’s “sometime in January” refer to the same nursing action that contemporary reports say began Feb 1/2, or to a separate prior workplace action?
Was there a public picket or other public gathering in Lesotho by Jan 31, 2021, and if so on what date/location?
Is any simultaneous crowd of at least 50 evidenced for January?
Were the grievances directed to government salary policy/PPP obligations, to the private operator, or both?
What happened physically after the last February activity; when did the action end?
